## Type

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Fix or wording change to an existing skill

## Checklist

- [ ] Frontmatter is valid YAML with `name` and `description`
- [ ] Folder name matches `name` exactly
- [ ] Description says what the skill does and when to use it
- [ ] At least one good vs bad example is included
- [ ] Tested with two trigger prompts and one non-trigger prompt, noted in `examples/`
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, internal hostnames, or customer data
- [ ] README skill table and `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` updated
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
